# .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/

> **Status:** templates to be added.

Per [ADR-002 §10](../../docs/architecture/adr-002-repo-structure.md), issue templates
are deferred until we triage our first external issues. Planned templates:

- `bug_report.md` — reproducible defect with environment, steps, expected vs actual.
- `feature_request.md` — user-outcome framing; pointer to Product Vision for scope check.
- `spec_proposal.md` — a "should we build this?" discussion that precedes a PRD.
- `security.md` — **note:** genuinely sensitive security issues MUST go to the security
  contact path declared in `SECURITY.md` (to be added), not a public issue.
